explanation: It is held in Buñol, near Valencia, in late August. Local tradition traces it to a street food fight among young people in 1945.

claims.text: La Tomatina, the tomato-throwing festival, takes place in Spain, in the town of Buñol.

Local tradition traces La Tomatina to a food fight among young people in Buñol in 1945.
